email.known_issue: ConvertToHtml file lock in harness (not API defect)

fail_explanation: Email ConvertToHtml file lock: harness using-block disposes input stream before async output completes. Fix: read bytes first or avoid using-block. Not an API defect.

api_corrections_discovered.diagram: DiagramConverter only supports Visio output formats (not SVG/PNG/PDF). Use PdfConverter for PDF output.
api_corrections_discovered.email: All Converter methods return Task (async). Use .GetAwaiter().GetResult() for sync code. Input via Stream + FolderOutputHandler for output.
api_corrections_discovered.slides: Compress modifies Presentation in-place and requires manual Save() after. Convert.ToPdf and AutoByExtension produce identical results for same input.

recommendation: All three families can proceed to controlled pilot after healing sprint completes and YAML configs are promoted.
